notes:
OPTiC opens straight away.

It no longer waits on the licence server to start up. Once your key has been verified on a PC it stays verified, and the "Offline - running on your last verified licence" message is gone for good.

New: a Report a bug button in the top bar. Say what happened, paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V, send.

Also in this release: two lighter themes (Parchment and Light) for anyone who finds the dark ones hard to read, buttons and boxes you can actually see on every theme, and you can now choose which kinds of activity show in the list instead of filtering to one at a time. Plus a number of smaller fixes.

Nothing you need to do after updating.
